sources.summary: A random X poster urged Elon Musk to hire Jensen Huang just hours before the former Nvidia chief resigned from his position.
sources.summary_zh: 就在这位 Nvidia 前首席执行官辞职前几个小时，一张随机的 X 海报敦促埃隆·马斯克聘用黄仁勋。
